purpose: Define conservation rules preventing one underlying work/evidence unit from multiplying Merit/Tier qualification through arbitrary splitting, duplication or recursive Project structure.

value.source_rule: Merit evidence retains exact underlying Project/work/time provenance.
value.duplicate_rule: Same underlying evidence unit cannot count repeatedly for the same criterion unless policy explicitly allows distinct dimensions.
value.time_rule: Splitting week→hours conserves total represented work time.
value.project_rule: Recursive Project parent/child structure cannot multiply one leaf work event into multiple qualifying Project outcomes by projection alone.
value.recommendation_rule: Same recommendation cannot be duplicated through copies/aliases.
value.recompute_rule: Recalculation deduplicates by exact evidence identity/provenance.

invariants.rule: Identity, portfolio, merit, recommendation, trust and competence states derive only from explicit provenance-bearing evidence; display text, self-authored claims, ranking position or AI inference never become verified evidence by themselves.

Distinct canonical identities maintain independent evidence histories; merit, Tier, trust and recommendation histories are not mergeable across identities unless a future explicit canonical identity-merger contract exists.

hard_gates.condition: same leaf Project counted through every ancestor
same artifact imported twice becomes two merits
